basic_info.description: Nestled on a tranquil cul-de-sac in San Franciscos prestigious Forest Hills neighborhood, this newly updated brick-and-slate detached home exudes elegance and luxury. Perched at an elevated vantage point, the home offers a captivating city and ocean view while remaining just steps from charming shops and restaurants in the West Portal area, Golden Gate Park, and Ocean Beach. This exquisite residence offers 4 bedrooms with a thoughtfully updated interior, featuring new flooring and beautifully remodeled kitchen and bathrooms. High-end finishes include RH and West Elm vanities, RH lighting, a DWR chandelier, Emtek door hardware, and Bosch appliances. A standout feature is the courtyard study a versatile bonus room with a floor-to-ceiling glass wall that frames an enchanting terraced garden with mature fruit trees, intricate brickwork, lion head fountain, and a patio perfect for outdoor entertaining. The lower level offers a private en-suite bedroom, ideal for guests. Additional conveniences include an interior laundry closet and car garage access with street parking.
